historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved conditional-use authorization to demolish the existing small single-family house at the rear and replace it with a four-story-over-garage, 50-foot-high residential building containing eight dwelling units, with amendments.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition as staff recommended. The present building dates from 2006.
An existing small single-family house stood at the rear of the lot. The present building dates from 2006.
